packets.objective: Add one candidate source-to-observation extractor behind the source-bound provider interface and evaluate it without granting canonical authority.
acceptance: Provider consumes only authorized source text and binds every result to its source SHA-256.
Outputs use ASSERTED/ALTERNATIVE/UNRESOLVED/ABSTAIN with calibrated confidence.
All nine extraction task families receive explicit evidence or documented non-support.
No provider output can authorize canonical state write.
Held-out evaluation reports per-task precision/recall/F1, false certainty, ambiguity preservation, calibration and risk-coverage rather than a universal narrative score.
packets.stop_condition: Do not tune repeatedly on the held-out source split. If one candidate cannot be evaluated without leakage or proprietary evidence custody, stop and repair the evaluation boundary first.

packets.objective: Expand the synthetic corpus into source-held-out public-domain/human-adjudicated evaluation slices with provenance and work-level split isolation.
acceptance: Entire works/authors held out where practical.
No adjacent-passage train/test leakage.
Explicit event/coreference/temporal/causal/perspective/function annotation guidance.
Ambiguous and intentionally unresolved cases represented rather than forcibly labeled.
No hidden Book-Eval gold and no bulk copyrighted body acquisition.
packets.stop_condition: Do not enlarge the corpus merely for volume; add cases only when they cover a named stress slice, relation family, disagreement mode or observed extractor failure.

packets.objective: Harden focalization, knowledge/perception/belief and revelation/open-question extraction because current narrative benchmarks identify perspective and revelation as under-evaluated.
acceptance: Knowledge-before-exposure false positives measured.
Narrator/focalizer identity not conflated.
Intentional omniscience remains representable.
Open questions and delayed revelations cannot be auto-closed without evidence.
Human-review path remains available for constitutively subjective perspective interpretations.
packets.stop_condition: Do not create a new perspective taxonomy unless an observed case cannot be represented by existing KNOWS/BELIEVES/PERCEIVES/FOCALIZES plus status/provenance fields.

packets.objective: Add explicit editorial stage/scope/query/escalation metadata to future author/editor review packets without changing current manuscript decisions.
acceptance: Developmental/line/copy/mechanical scope is explicit when applicable.
Reason for human escalation is explicit.
Original-retained default remains explicit.
No queued item is auto-resolved or manuscript-mutated by schema migration.
packets.stop_condition: Do not rewrite existing author dispositions; apply the metadata contract prospectively or via evidence-preserving migration only.

packets.objective: Measure repeated-revision drift in project voice/cultural/lexical/cadence distributions without named-author targets.
acceptance: Compare against the project/book baseline rather than an external prestige style.
Track diversity/identity drift across revision rounds.
Treat drift as a preservation risk signal, not a universal quality penalty.
Preserve protected irregularity and culturally specific expression.
packets.stop_condition: Do not optimize toward a single diversity statistic or infer demographic identity from prose.

not_prioritized: automatic resolution of the three book-level AGLO author review items
